content: Geeyontta Asata
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Inchchirachcha hargey iza bolla dizaade woykko iza bollaafe haaththa malay goggizaade woykko aha bochchidi tunidaade ubbaa Isra7eele asay ba diza gutappe kare kessana mala azaza.
Tani isttara diza istta guta istti tunisontta mala heyta geeyontta asata ubbaa adde gidiin macca gidiin intte giddofe kessi gooddite.»
GODAY Muse azazida mala Isra7eele asay ba gutappe istta kessi gooddides.
Qoho Gishshas Qanxxo Imo
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, maccafe gidiin attumasappe ay asikka GODAAS ammanettonttaade gidi beettidi ay asa bollaka qoho gaththiko hessaadey qohanchcha.
Izi ba nagara paaxo; ba qohoza gishshas qanxxettiza miishshaa bolla xeetappe nam7u tammu kushe gujjidi qohettidaades eho.

Gido attiin he qohettidaadey hayqqidaa gidikkonne edaa ekkanaas izas mata dabboy bayndaa gidikko he eday GODAASSA; he edatiza eday qohidaade nagara wursana shiiqiza yarshos immiza dharshozara issife qeesezas imetto.
Hessa malan Isra7eele asay GODAAS immiza dumma imotay wurikka he imotaa ekkiza qeesezas gido.
Issi issi asi GODAAS immiza dumma imotay he imotaa immidaadessa; gido attiin izi qeesezas immizaa gidikko he miishshay qeesezassa.»
Ammanettontta Machcheta
Hessafe guye GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Isra7eele asaappe issaade machcha ba azinaas ammanettontta aggada kare kare giikko,
hara addera zin7iko, qasseka iza ooththida tuna oosoy qonccontta azinappe geemmidaa gidikko, izi bolla markkattiza asi beettontta aggiin izi tunateththay qonccontta aggiko,
iza tunida gishshas izi azinay izo sidhanaas dandayees; woykko iza tunontta dishin izi qanaaten kumida gishshas ba machcho sidhana dandayees.

Hessaadey ba machchiyo qeesekko ekki eho; he maccassay gishshas koyettiza issi kilo bangga dhiille yarshos ekki yo; hayssi qanaates shiiqiza kaththa yarshoy qoho qofsizaaz gidiza gishshas zayte iza bolla gussofo; exaanekka iza bolla woththofo.
«Qeesezi maccassayo efidi GODAA sinththan esso.
Geeshsha haath xaaron duuqqi ekko; Gaytoteththa Dunkaane wuygeppe guuththa biitta ekkidi he haaththaan gujjo.
Qeesezi maccassayo GODAA sinththan esso; izi goosse birsho; qanaates shiiqiza kaththa yarshoza izi kushen woththo; qasse he qeesezi qanggeth ehiza camo haath xaarora ba kushen oykko.
Qeesezi izo hizgi caaqeththo; neni ne azinara dishin hara addey nenara aqontta gidikkonne neni nena tunisontta gidikko qanggeth ehiza hayssi camo haaththay nees gometoppo.
Gido attiin neni ne azinappe hara addera zin7ada tunidaa gidikko,
‹GODAY nees yela ulo melisonne ne ulo puuriso! Ne dereza garsan nena caaqossinne qanggeththas kesso.
Hayssi haaththazi gede ne bolla giddo gelidi ne uloza puuriso! Nees yela uloza gundiso!› Maccassayakka, ‹Amiin! GODAY ta bolla hessaththo ooththo› ga zaaru.
«Hessafe guye qeesezi hessa he qanggeththa qaala xaaththa maxaafan xaafo; he xaafoyssaka camo haaththazi diza xaarozan yeggi meecco.
Izi maccassayo iita sako oyththiza camo haaththaa izo ushshanaappe sinththan,
qeesezi maccassayfe yarsho dhiilleza ekkidi GODAAS yaanne haa qaaseththi shiishshiza dumma yarsho gidana mala yarsho yarshizasoza bolla shiishsho.
Hessafe guye kaththa yarsho issi zolla dhiille ekkidi qofso yarsho gidana mala yarsho yarshizasoza bolla xuuggo; wurseththan he maccassayo he haaththaa ushsho.

Maccassaya bana tunisada ba azinaas diza ammaneteththaa pacinchchidaa gidikko qanggeth ehiza haaththaa iza uyiza wode izi bolla giddon wolqqama sako ehana; hessika izi uloy puurana; izis yela uloy gundana; izi sunththi izi dereza giddon qanggettidaaz gidi attana.
Gido attiin iza aykko moorokka ooththonttaa gidikko izi bolla aykko qohoykka gakkenna; iza naytakka yelana.
«Issaadey ba machcho laymateththan sidhiza wode ooththana wogay hayssafe kaallizayssa; iza kare kare gaada hara addera zin7ada tunidaa gidikko,
woykko issi asi ba machcho coo mela sidhizaa gidikko iza GODAA sinththan eqqana mala ooththo.
Izi azinazikka qohoppe geesh gidana; maccassaya laymata beettidaa gidikko qasse iza ba qohoza gaason ba bolla gakkiza pirda ekkana.»
